name: Pamyeorui Otaku
source:
The protagonist, Jin Da-yeon, is a die-hard fan of the Japanese idol game, "Idol☆Star."

Upon hearing that limited-edition character perfumes are launching in Japan, she ends up leading a group purchase for the merchandise.

However, being terrible with money, she impulsively spends all the collected funds on personal expenses.

Only 14 days left until the order deadline...

Can she scrape together $5,000 in time to place the order?

Face reality and reform... or escape to the internet and face doom?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3318210/Doomed_Otaku/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
女主角甄莎妍是日本偶像养成游戏《偶像☆星》的狂热死忠粉。

听说日本即将推出限量版角色香水后，她主动牵头组织了一场周边拼团代购。

然而毫无理财观念的她一时冲动，竟把收上来的拼团货款全都挥霍在了个人开销上。

距离截单期限只剩最后14天……

她能否及时东拼西凑出5000美元顺利下单？

是直面现实、痛改前非……还是逃进网络世界，一步步走向破灭？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3318210/Doomed_Otaku/]Steam[/url]]
